meta.name: Entity Detail Workspace
meta.description: Compact entity orientation, critical attention, grouped section navigation, primary detail content, contextual information, and sensitive actions.

purpose: Allow users to understand one domain entity, review its current state, navigate related information, and perform contextual actions without losing orientation.
useWhen: The dominant task concerns one entity.
The entity has several meaningful information groups or workflows.
Users need persistent orientation while navigating entity sections.
Actions depend on entity state, permissions, or context.
doNotUseWhen: The primary task is comparing many entities.
The screen is only a short creation form.
The entity contains too little information to justify section navigation.
The workflow is a dedicated review-and-approval comparison.

selectionQuestions: Which identity fields are required for orientation?
Which entity conditions require immediate attention?
Which sections are primary, supporting, contextual, or audit?
Does section state belong in the route or URL?
Which actions apply globally to the entity and which belong inside sections?
Can contextual content remain visible beside the primary content?
Which information may be progressively disclosed?

regions.name: Breadcrumbs
regions.role: Provide route and collection orientation without duplicating entity identity.
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when route hierarchy improves orientation.

compact.layout: Compact back link or shortened breadcrumbs.

medium.notes: Current entity name may remain in the header instead.

rules: Breadcrumbs describe user-oriented hierarchy.
Current entity identity remains in the entity header.
Breadcrumbs use links except the current page.

regions.name: Compact Entity Header
regions.role: Identify the entity, summarize current state, and expose limited entity-level actions.
prohibitedComponents: Large repeated edit buttons for every field

compact.layout: Stack identity, status, essential metadata, and primary action.

medium.layout: Identity and metadata left; actions wrap.

ultrawide.notes: Do not expose additional low-value metadata simply to fill width.

rules: The entity header provides orientation, not a complete summary.
One entity-level primary action is allowed when justified.
Exports and low-frequency utilities move to overflow.
Raw UUIDs remain hidden unless operationally required.

regions.name: Critical Entity Attention
regions.role: Surface entity-specific risks, deadlines, conflicts, or blocking conditions.
prohibitedComponents: Automated suggestion represented as confirmed decision
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when the entity requires immediate attention.

wide.notes: Do not create several competing danger cards.

rules: Only material entity-specific risk appears here.
Automated findings are labeled as suggestions until confirmed.
Critical alerts remain distinct from ordinary status badges.

regions.name: Section Navigation
regions.role: Navigate grouped entity information and workflows without horizontal overflow or unstable ordering.
prohibitedComponents: Different section order on different routes
Navigation labels taken directly from backend modules

sticky.compactBehavior: Transform to grouped select, compact navigation, or disclosure menu.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when the entity has several approved sections.

compact.layout: Grouped select or compact disclosure navigation.
compact.notes: Do not use an inaccessible horizontally scrolling tab row.

medium.layout: Wrapped grouped navigation or compact side navigation.
medium.notes: Secondary sections may move to overflow.

wide.placement: Below critical attention or as a left section rail when approved.
wide.layout: Grouped horizontal or vertical section navigation.
wide.notes: Section grouping reduces excessive individual tabs.

ultrawide.placement: Persistent section navigation beside or above content.
ultrawide.notes: Do not expose every subfeature as an equal top-level tab.

rules: Section order remains predictable.
Section navigation state uses route or validated URL state when shareable.
Labels use user-oriented domain terminology.
Narrow layouts transform structurally rather than relying on clipped tabs.

regions.name: Primary Entity Content
regions.role: Render the active entity section or primary entity workflow.

compact.notes: Feature components own their internal compact behavior.

medium.layout: Single primary content column with supporting content below.

wide.layout: Primary content with optional contextual aside.
wide.notes: The active section selects an approved nested recipe when necessary.

ultrawide.layout: Primary content with persistent contextual aside when useful.
ultrawide.notes: Reading and form content remain constrained.

rules: Each active section has a clear purpose and heading.
The active section may use a nested approved recipe.
The primary content does not repeat orientation information unnecessarily.
State boundaries remain local when possible.

regions.name: Contextual Aside
regions.role: Keep supporting metadata, activity, related entities, or contextual actions visible without competing with the primary task.
prohibitedComponents: Critical alerts hidden only in the aside

sticky.compactBehavior: Move below primary content or into grouped disclosure sections.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when persistent supporting context improves the primary task.

compact.placement: Below primary content or inside grouped disclosures.
compact.notes: Do not place essential primary actions only here.

wide.notes: Remain subordinate to the primary content.

rules: The aside contains supporting, not primary, content.
Critical information remains visible before the main content.
Sticky behavior is disabled when content exceeds usable viewport height.
Long contextual content may move to a dedicated section.

regions.name: Audit and Technical Details
regions.role: Provide accountability, history, or technical context to authorized users through progressive disclosure.
prohibitedComponents: Technical content presented before primary operational information
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only to eligible roles and when audit or diagnostic context is required.

compact.notes: Technical identifiers wrap or copy safely.

wide.placement: Dedicated section or secondary navigation group.
wide.notes: Do not expose raw transport values.

ultrawide.placement: Dedicated section or secondary navigation group.

rules: Audit data is not removed for visual simplicity.
Technical details are separated from ordinary user-facing content.
Sensitive technical values remain masked or omitted.
Timestamps use the approved user-facing format with optional technical detail for authorized contexts.

regions.name: Entity Action Surface
regions.role: Provide persistent or contextual actions when the active workflow requires them to remain available.
prohibitedComponents: Duplicate actions already present in the header
Destructive action adjacent to primary action without separation
Action without permission or state eligibility

sticky.compactBehavior: Render a compact bottom action surface only when it does not obscure content.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when the active section requires persistent actions.

compact.placement: Bottom of active content or compact sticky action surface.
compact.layout: One primary action with secondary overflow.
compact.notes: Must not cover focused controls or error messages.

medium.notes: Sticky only when task continuity benefits.

wide.placement: Bottom of active section or contextual aside.

ultrawide.placement: Bottom of active section or contextual aside.
ultrawide.notes: Keep actions grouped by semantic priority.

rules: Persistent actions are used only for active editing or review workflows.
One primary action is visually dominant.
Destructive actions are separated and confirmed.
Pending state prevents duplicate execution.

composition.columnPolicy: Single-column orientation and navigation followed by one primary content column with an optional constrained contextual aside.
spacingOwnership: The recipe owns spacing between breadcrumbs, entity header, critical attention, navigation, and content layout.
The active section owns spacing between its internal subsections.
The contextual aside owns internal panel gaps.
The action surface owns action spacing.
surfacePolicy: The entity header may use one orientation surface.
Primary content does not require a card around every subsection.
The contextual aside uses a subtle supporting surface.
Critical attention uses semantic critical treatment.
rules: Entity orientation remains visible before section content.
Section order is stable.
Primary content remains wider than contextual content.
Audit details remain available through progressive disclosure.
prohibited: Long horizontal tab rows that clip or overflow.
Repeated full entity header in every section.
Every field represented by a full-width edit button.
Primary and destructive actions with identical treatment.
Raw DTO or JSON display in ordinary sections.

actions.primaryPlacement: Entity header for one entity-level action or active section action surface for workflow-specific submission.
actions.secondaryPlacement: Entity-header overflow, section toolbars, or contextual aside.
actions.destructivePlacement: Separated in overflow or a dedicated destructive area with confirmation.
actions.bulkPlacement: Not normally applicable to one entity.
actions.contextualPlacement: Inside the active section or contextual aside.
actions.overflowPolicy: Exports, audit utilities, and infrequent actions move to overflow.
actions.compactBehavior: Preserve one primary action and move secondary or utility actions to overflow or the active section.
rules: Do not repeat the same action in the header, section, and sticky footer.
Action eligibility reflects current entity state and capability.
Automated suggestions and human-confirmed actions remain distinct.

content.headingPolicy: One h1 identifies the entity; active sections use h2, and nested subsections use h3.
content.longContentPolicy: Entity names, case numbers, labels, and metadata must wrap or truncate according to explicit content contracts.
content.truncationPolicy: Identity and critical decision values remain accessible in full; lower-priority metadata may truncate.
content.emptyStatePlacement: Section-specific empty states replace only the active section content and preserve entity orientation.
content.loadingStrategy: Render stable entity-header and section skeletons; preserve orientation during section refetch.
content.errorScope: Entity fetch failures affect the route; active section failures remain local when entity orientation remains valid.
rules: Missing, unknown, zero, not-applicable, and not-calculated values remain distinct.
Technical identifiers appear only in approved audit contexts.
Section labels use user-facing terminology.

responsive.minimumViewport: 320 CSS pixels with stacked sections and compact section navigation.
responsive.zoomExpectation: The detail workspace must remain usable at 125% browser zoom.
responsive.internalOverflowPolicy: Nested tables may own controlled horizontal scrolling; ordinary entity content must wrap or stack.

transformations.change: Keep the contextual aside constrained and preserve the primary content width.
Move the contextual aside below primary content and reduce section navigation density.
transformations.reason: The primary workflow requires sufficient horizontal space.

transformations.change: Stack entity header content, transform section navigation into a compact grouped control, and move secondary actions to overflow.
transformations.reason: Compact viewports cannot sustain a wide header, horizontal navigation, and contextual column.

states.rendering: Preserve current entity orientation and active section while indicating background refresh.
Render entity identity, status, section navigation, active content, contextual information, and eligible actions.
Render section-specific explanation and next action without removing entity orientation.
states.userAction: Create, upload, configure, or return according to section purpose.

states.rendering: Keep successful entity regions visible while isolating failed or unavailable sections.
states.userAction: Continue or retry the affected section.

states.rendering: Use route-level recovery when the entity cannot be loaded and local recovery for optional sections.
states.userAction: Retry or return to the parent collection.

states.rendering: Render an approved permission state or read-only variant according to capability policy.
states.userAction: Return or continue in read-only mode.

states.rendering: Preserve usable entity content with explicit freshness or conflict warning.
Render an explicit processing state for uploads, analysis, imports, or server calculations.
states.userAction: Wait or continue in unaffected sections.

landmarkMap: Breadcrumbs and section navigation use separately labeled nav landmarks.
Entity header uses a header region within the inherited main landmark.
Persistent action surfaces use a labeled region when necessary.
headingStructure: Audit and contextual sections use headings appropriate to their nesting.
keyboard: Active section changes provide appropriate focus or orientation.
Sticky actions do not intercept focus order unexpectedly.
Contextual disclosures and drawers restore focus.
announcements: Active section changes should update page orientation where necessary.
Critical state changes require status communication.
Background refresh must not repeatedly interrupt users.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Entity status, critical attention, selection, automated suggestion, and confirmation state do not depend only on color.
rules: Do not create several unlabeled nav landmarks.
Collapsed section navigation must expose the active section.
Section error states require meaningful headings or accessible labels.

prohibitedPatterns: Repeated entity identity in every section.
Every field presented as a large full-width action.
Raw backend identifiers in ordinary content.
Primary content narrower than contextual content.
Critical information hidden only in a secondary tab.
dataMagnitude: Entity names and labels may be long.
An entity may contain many sections, but only approved groups appear in primary navigation.
Timelines, documents, or related records may require nested list recipes.
performance: Load heavy secondary sections lazily when appropriate.
Do not refetch every section for one local mutation without cache analysis.
Preserve entity orientation during section loading.
implementation: Section state uses routes or validated URL state when shareable.
TanStack Query owns entity server state.
Capability checks control actions and read-only behavior.
Machine presence conditions come from presenceDefaults; visibilityCondition prose is explanatory only.

presenceDefaults.rationale: Detail wayfinding appears when a real parent route or collection context exists.
Entity detail always requires identity and current-state orientation.
Critical entity attention disappears when no material entity-specific risk exists.
A single-section entity does not render navigation chrome for a choice that does not exist.
Every entity-detail screen requires one primary content workflow, including section-level empty and error states.
Persistent supporting context exists only when the approved screen contract shows that it materially improves the primary task.
Audit detail appears only when relevant audit context exists and the current capability may disclose it.
Persistent entity actions render only when the active section genuinely needs actions to remain available.

checks.description: The entity-detail recipe must validate against the layout recipe schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing recipe fields.

checks.description: Section navigation must not clip, overlap, or create inaccessible horizontal overflow.
checks.remediation: Apply grouped navigation and the approved compact transformation.

checks.description: Primary, supporting, contextual, and audit content must remain visually distinct.
checks.remediation: Correct content hierarchy and progressive disclosure.

checks.description: The contextual aside must move below or collapse before it compresses the primary workflow.
Automated suggestions must remain visually and semantically distinct from human-confirmed decisions.
checks.remediation: Use approved suggestion, review, and confirmation patterns.

checks.description: Entity-detail orientation, section navigation, contextual, audit, and persistent-action regions must follow typed recipe presence semantics.
checks.remediation: Correct craftDefaults/presenceDefaults and keep conditional regions required=false with cardinality.minimum=0.

examples.description: Compact case identity, procedural status, critical deadlines, grouped sections, primary case content, contextual metadata, and audit history.

examples.description: Organization identity, status, administrators, modules, billing configuration, activity, and sensitive actions.
